polityNote: Swaziland (British protectorate until 1968-09-06), then the Kingdom of Swaziland / Eswatini. First level: the four districts formed in 1963-12, called regions since 2005-07-26. Atoms are the four regions of geoBoundaries SWZ ADM1 (OpenStreetMap, 2017). The six (1946) / seven (Müller-Crepon 1914 section) colonial districts before 1963 are not drawn here. Independent check (①): atom area / statoids area — Hhohho 3,665/3,569 = 1.027, Lubombo 5,846/5,945 = 0.983, Manzini 4,099/4,070 = 1.007, Shiselweni 3,785/3,779 = 1.002; all four regions' 2017 OSM tinkhundla (gb ADM2, 53) nest in them.

sources.title: Statoids — Regions of Swaziland (Gwillim Law, updated 2015-06-30)
sources.says: 1946: six districts (Bremersdorp, Hlatikulu, Mankaiana, Mbabane, Pigg's Peak, Stegi). 1963-12: reorganised into four districts. ~1980 capital of Shiselweni moved to Nhlangano; 2005-07-26 districts became regions. No boundary change after 1963.
